# TokenAAS Examples Security Policy

This repository contains public example code. Bugs in an example can be reported with the issue form, but suspected vulnerabilities in the TokenAAS service or authentication flow must be reported privately.

Email [admin@tokenaas.ai](mailto:admin@tokenaas.ai?subject=TokenAAS%20Security%20Report) with the affected endpoint or example, reproduction steps, impact, relevant request IDs and sanitized logs.

Never send production API keys, passwords, session cookies, private keys, payment data, or unredacted personal information. Use synthetic data and revoke any credential that may have been exposed.

Do not create a public issue until TokenAAS confirms that coordinated disclosure is appropriate. Limit testing to accounts and data you own, and do not perform denial-of-service testing, credential stuffing, destructive actions, or high-volume automated scanning.
